items.title: Keenan Allen: Facing league suspension
items.description:
Allen "is facing a minimum three-game suspension" in connection with his August arrest, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Penix: Could start in Week 3
items.description:
Penix (knee) could start Thursday's game against the Packers, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Jalen McMillan: Should play on snap count
items.description:
McMillan (knee) is set to play Sunday against the Browns but "is not expected to have a full-time role just yet," Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kaelon Black: On track to play Sunday
items.description:
Black (groin) is on track to play Sunday against the Dolphins, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Looking like game-time call
items.description:
Nacua (hip) is considered by the Rams "to be a pre-game decision" for Monday's game against the Giants, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
